status.description: The issue is open and ready for the assignee to start work on it.

comments.comment:
the root cause is that sometimes precreate is not completed in time and then OST objects are created on unexpected OSTs with an unexpected sequence obviously:

/mnt/lustre/d155.conf-sanity/f155.conf-sanity
lmm_stripe_count:  1
lmm_stripe_size:   4194304
lmm_pattern:       raid0
lmm_layout_gen:    0
lmm_stripe_offset: 1
	obdidx		 objid		 objid		 group
	     1	             4	          0x4	   0x2c0000402

/mnt/lustre/d155.conf-sanity/f155.conf-sanity2
lmm_stripe_count:  1
lmm_stripe_size:   4194304
lmm_pattern:       raid0
lmm_layout_gen:    0
lmm_stripe_offset: 0
	obdidx		 objid		 objid		 group
	     0	             3	          0x3	   0x280000402

test-framework calls sleep_maxage() to ensure precreation is ready:

exhaust_precreations() {
	__exhaust_precreations $1 $2 $3
	sleep_maxage
}
